escalation_entity_en: Ministry of Public Works and Transport
routing_notes: CDR handles national/primary roads and highways. Municipal roads are the responsibility of the respective local municipality. Use GPS district to select primary entity. If GPS unavailable or district unresolved, default to CDR and flag for human review.

Route to the regional water authority determined by GPS governorate: Beirut + Mount Lebanon → BMLWE; North Lebanon + Akkar → NLWE; South Lebanon + Nabatieh → SLWE; Bekaa + Baalbek-Hermel → BWE. Use municipality_responsibility_map for authority lookup by district.

EDL handles the national electricity grid. However many areas rely on private generator operators (moualid) for supplemental power, which are not public entities. HITL always required to confirm whether the fault is EDL grid, local distributor, or private generator. Do not auto-route electricity complaints.

Primary responsibility is the respective local municipality. In Greater Beirut, Beirut Municipality coordinates with contracted collection operators. Ministry of Environment handles illegal dumping and public health violations. CDR handles waste at reconstruction or infrastructure project sites.

Civil Defense (Défense Civile) for emergency flood response and rescue. Municipality for street-level drainage blockages and maintenance. CDR for failures in national drainage infrastructure. Civil Defense is always notified first; municipality handles follow-up drainage repair.

column14: HITL always required for safety complaints. ISF for public safety incidents and criminal matters. Civil Defense for structural hazards, fire risk, and collapse risk. Never auto-route safety complaints. Human reviewer confirms entity and urgency before dispatch.

Sector unclear. Route to human review without prediction. Reviewer assigns sector and entity manually. Every OTHER complaint corrected by a reviewer becomes a training label for the IEP-1 issue-type classifier.
